name: LockedIn
tagline: Set one goal; AI watches your screen and webcam and steps in when you drift.

awards: Charles Chang Institute of Entrepreneurship Prize Track

problem: Timers and to-do lists do not provide real-time accountability, especially for people with attention difficulties.
solution: The user states an intention; Gemini compares desktop activity with it and the webcam checks attention, intervening when they do not match.
demo_moment: Team-described: open a distracting site and get called out.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Charles Chang Institute of Entrepreneurship Prize Track” among 217 submissions.
Pitched as accountability for attention difficulties.

lessons: An entrepreneurship prize rewards a sharp user and a clear habit loop.
